summary: Overall, this is a strong, well-structured mission design. You address all major elements and support them with STK screenshots, access data and hand calculations. The main improvements are the optimistic revisit calculation, missing X-band link budget/ground-segment verification, the rideshare release-orbit assumption, and Table 5 UTC/local wording. Embedding the STK files will make your evidence fully verifiable.
next_steps: Revise Section 2.3: use the ~134 km daily equatorial track shift and ~280 km half-swath rather than dividing 2,698 km by 560 km; report a realistic maximum revisit (order 8-20 days) or justify the 5-day claim with target-specific access results.

Add an X-band link budget in Section 2.4 and verify the Mount Pleasant 12 m ground-segment modification; correct Table 5's UTC/local-time wording and clarify the rideshare release orbit/trim in Section 2.2.
Make the STK evidence fully verifiable by embedding key screenshots and including the software files in Appendix A, and refine the Introduction's bathymetry-versus-satellite-imagery rationale.

criteria.C1: You address all C1 requirements clearly in Section 1: mission need, single-spacecraft rationale, operator AIMS and customers GBRMPA, with appropriate citations. To move toward the top of Accomplished, sharpen the rationale by distinguishing bathymetric mapping [3] from satellite imagery rather than conflating them at 100 m/pixel.
criteria.C2: You cover all major design elements with STK screenshots, access data and hand calculations (Sections 2.2-2.5). To strengthen: revise the Section 2.3 revisit calculation using the ~134 km daily track shift and ~280 km half-swath; add an X-band link budget and verify the Mount Pleasant 12 m ground-segment assumption in Section 2.4; clarify the rideshare release orbit/trim in Section 2.2; correct Table 5 UTC/local wording; embed STK files.
criteria.C3: Your Section 3 conclusion is specific and quantitative, and you record four limitations, which is strong. To move toward the top of Accomplished, explicitly link each limitation to the affected design choice and state the next verification step, so the conclusion reads as a clear evidence-based close rather than a list.
criteria.C4: Your report has a clear engineering structure, a concise executive summary, labelled figures/tables and consistent citations. To move toward the top of Accomplished, polish minor awkward phrasing and resolve small labelling ambiguities; ensure every figure/table is explicitly referenced in text and that listed STK files are accessible so presentation evidence is fully verifiable.
